answer: The dune edge is logged both ways, so a closed ring of 32 clones produces a signature the nectar analysis flags immediately. An attacker must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, so that doing work rather than printing keys, and the shale settlement applies the void retroactively. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. That is 28 dollars per alias.
